notes.title: MHK4 | Update 1.1.0 | Time Trials
notes.content: [p]Hello racers![/p][p]We are very happy to announce a new, major update to [i]Moorhuhn Kart 4[/i], which adds a whole new game mode: [/p][h1][b]Time Trials[/b][/h1][p]Have a go at cracking the current track record by going against players from all over the world. Stay on the heels of the current best players by pursuing their ghost and learn new shortcuts, tricks and tactics.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157392/7cbf373cfdfff61477bd542caf4703e394934655.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Leaderboards[/h1][p]Your time will be up there for all to see on the Online Leaderboards. Check how your friends are doing, or even tackle the top players by setting a new all-time record.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157392/2bafab865b549166748e5708b57259475b0fb53f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Right now, the leaderboards have all been wiped clean from the beta tests, so you can be one of the first to enter the challenge and submit your times![/p][p][/p][h1]Balancing[/h1][p]In preparation for this update, we also had a long look at the current kart parts and chose to rebalance some stats, to make some part combinations more viable for competetive gameplay.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157392/b2cac691912516a6eaee6b9dbed60f66683f7bf5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Changelog[/h1][h2][b]General[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added Time Trials mode[/p][/*][*][p]Result screen now shows which Kart Parts were unlocked[/p][/*][*][p]Added Cross-Platform Play toggle in Settings & Matchmaking menu[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Room Code length from 6 to 8 to support better error feedback on connection failures[/p][/*][*][p]Added player reporting options in the Lobby screen and in-game Pause Menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added platform icons to player names in Online mode[/p][/*][*][p]Online Terms of Service now shown when entering Online Mode the first time[/p][/*][*][p]Touched up singleplayer mode icons[/p][/*][*][p]Added new background to Credits screen[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed blinking animation of various characters (especially the sheep in Sven’s meadow)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing characters in font display[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Gameplay[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Increased top speed & top boost speed for underperforming Kart Parts to better align them with their counterparts[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: MHK4 | Development News
notes.content:
Hey Racers! It's been a few slow weeks during Easter,  time to speed things up with a few updates:

[h2]Demo Updates[/h2]
The demo has finally caught up and contains all previous updates. It is now also available on PS4 and Nintendo Switch. 🎉
To improve the memory footprint across all platforms, [i]Tangled Tracks[/i] has been removed from the demo.

[h2]Coming Updates[/h2]
[h3]Online Performance[/h3]
We're currently working on a major netcode update to optimize packet sizes and improve network performance. 

[h3]New Game Mode[/h3]
Alongside that, we are also working on a highly requested addition to the existing game modes. 
Both changes are on the larger side, so they'll need a few more weeks. We will update you once it is ... time.

[h3]Livestream[/h3]
We will also hold another Live Racing Event this Friday 18:00 CET! Join us for some light chatting, hard racing and furious drifting!

[h2]Stay in touch[/h2]
Join our Discord to find new players, and stay up to date with development.

[url=https://discord.gg/j4HCKTYXqg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157392/2543ae740406a8856233357fae6602a6d1cd3bf6.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: MHK4 | Update 1.0.14 | Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings, drivers! This update not only adds several fixes and improvements, but also the brand new award ceremony at the end of each Grand Prix. Happy Racing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157392/31755dcc9248422bc4441d44dfaee4f079011407.jpg[/img]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved UI scaling in Splitscreen setup screens.
[*] Added an award ceremony after completing a Grand Prix.
[*] Added indicators in track & Grand Prix selection screens to show whether the player has won the respective track or Grand Prix.
[*] Reduced the number of decimal places in the refresh rate dropdown.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a respawn trigger in Canyon.
[*] Fixed an issue causing inaccurate lap time recordings, which could result in players finishing simultaneously.
[*] Fixed an issue where rockets would sometimes fail to explode for clients.
[*] Fixed the Rocket Redirection achievement. 
[*] Fixed wrong sound being played when driving through the spiderwebs in Tangled Tracks
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Disabled drifting while affected by the Heart item.
[*] Slightly increased the acceleration stat for all engines.
[/list]

notes.title: MHK4 | Update 1.0.13 | Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Racers! We have a new update for you that brings several fixes and changes:

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Room code is now copied to the clipboard when made visible inside a room.
[*] Added an option to restart a single race via the pause menu or race end screen.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed rockets getting stuck inside caves in [i]Tangled Tracks[/i].
[*] Fixed decals not appearing on certain surfaces in [i]Sven’s Meadow[/i].
[*] Fixed minimap issues in [i]Temple of Huhn[/i].
[*] Fixed a loud sound sometimes playing when loading the next race in [i]Grand Prix[/i].
[*] Fixed an issue where the [i]'Down to the Wire[/i]' achievement did not work properly.
[*] Fixed placeholder text appearing in the driver list during splitscreen races.
[*] Fixed incorrect placement display on clients.
[*] Fixed lighting issues in [i]Canyon[/i] and [i]Nicely Iced[/i].
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved AI behavior
[*] Characters now play their joy animation on item hits.
[*] AI drivers can now receive a start boost after the countdown minigame.
[*] Drifts are now canceled when hit by items or hazards.
[*] Boosts should now feel more responsive for clients.
[*] Improved kart behavior at extremely high speeds in [i]Nicely Iced[/i].
[*] Improved various respawning issues.
[*] Improved routing in the [i]Nicely Iced[/i] cave.
[*] Improved lifting off and going out of bounds in [i]Jumpyard[/i].
[*] Fixed karts dropping instantly when hit mid-air by 16 Tons.
[*] Fixed getting blocked by other karts which are falling in a hole.
[*] Fixed a client-side desync in the countdown minigame.
[*] Added visual & audio feedback when slowed.
[*] TV item now adds a small slowdown
[*] Reduced the time to reset the kart when falling in holes or off the track
[*] Reduced intro camera flight time in online races from 30s to 10s
[/list]

notes.title: Moorhuhn Kart 4 is out now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
The wait is finally over - [b]it is launch day for Moorhuhn Kart 4[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157392/08ef987928fb8be38408e4a213bea5c2bb06d86d.jpg[/img]
It has been a lot of work for us at Korion Interactive, but we are glad to finally share our game with everyone.

[h2]Let us know what you think[/h2]
We can't wait to hear what you think of Moorhuhn Kart 4! 
Whether you are an old Moorhuhn Kart fan or new to the franchise, share your opinion, either in the Steam discussions or by leaving a review. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157392/68eab9be87f65ba6d3d7acc30b4fcad1912b0f60.png[/img]

If you're streaming, use the tag [b]#moorhuhnkart4[/b] so we can share!

[h2]Stay in touch[/h2]
Join our Discord to find new players, and stay up to date with development.
